title: A target named M31 with unset 0,0 coordinates passes validation, and the Slew node confirms in green that it 'Will use target: M31'
summary: Root cause is that TargetHeaderNode has no nullable coordinate, so a new target is born at exactly RA 0h / Dec +0 and every builder surface rendered that placeholder as a settled pointing. Added packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/widgets/target_coordinates.dart with a single documented predicate `targetCoordinatesUnset(node)` (exact 0/0) and made all four sequencer-builder surfaces honest about it: (1) _TargetResolutionPreview (shared by Slew and Center) no longer goes green with a check for an unaimed target -- it renders the amber alert with 'Target "M31" has no coordinates set - this node has nowhere to point'; (2) the tree card's RA/Dec chips print 'Not set' in warning colour instead of '00h 00m 00s' / '+00 00' 00"'; (3) the 'Frame target' button is disabled while the coordinates are the default, so the framing assistant can no longer show a random patch of Pisces under the target's name; (4) the target editor gained the name resolution it never had -- a new _CoordinateLookupSection with an explicit 'Coordinates not set' warning banner and a 'Look up coordinates' action backed by a new targetCoordinateLookupProvider that searches the target library (over the wire when this is a NetworkBackend client, matching the Quick-Start wizard's authority split) and then the installed planetarium catalogs, de-duped by catalog id. Tapping a result writes raHours/decDegrees (converting CatalogSearchResult's degrees to hours) plus catalogTargetId. Because SeedData.seedTargets is deliberately a no-op the library ships empty, so a miss reports 'No match ... Install a catalog from Settings > Catalogs, or enter RA/Dec above' rather than silently leaving the placeholder.
test: 3 tests in packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/target_coordinates_unset_test.dart: 'Slew editor refuses to confirm a target still on the 0h/+0 default', 'tree card prints "Not set" rather than 00h 00m 00s', 'target editor warns about the placeholder and resolves the name' (seeds a real M31 row into the in-memory targets table and drives the lookup end-to-end, asserting the provider's node ends up at 0.712306h / +41.26875).
caveats: Verified failing-without-fix in two passes: (a) stubbing targetCoordinatesUnset to `=> false` fails all 3 tests ('Found 1 widget with text containing Will use target', 'Found 1 widget with text "00h 00m 00s"', 'Found 0 widgets with text containing Coordinates not set'); (b) restoring that and removing only the _CoordinateLookupSection call site fails test 3 alone. Restored, all 3 pass, `flutter analyze lib/screens/sequencer` clean. Definition of 'unset' is exact (0.0, 0.0): a deliberate 0h/+0 pointing also reads as unset until nudged by 1e-4, which is documented at the predicate. Formatting deliberately follows the surrounding old-style layout -- the installed Dart formatter reflows the pre-existing tracked files too, so `dart format` was not applied. Four unrelated failures in test/screens/sequencer/ during the folder run (captures_landscape_test, run_dashboard/weather_safety_badge_test) are a concurrent agent's in-flight compile error in lib/screens/settings/widgets/connection_settings.dart ('The method _WorkLocallyButton isn't defined'), not a regression from this change. `graphify update .` deliberately not run: concurrent agents share graph.json.
needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/rules/target_rules.dart is outside my ownership. It still needs a TargetCoordinatesUnsetRule so Pre-Flight Validation raises an ERROR (not just the existing range checks at TargetCoordinatesRule lines 6-43, which only reject RA outside [0,24) and Dec outside [-90,90]) for any TargetHeaderNode with raHours == 0 && decDegrees == 0. Suggested wording: title 'Target Coordinates Not Set', description 'Target "<name>" is still at the 0h/+0 default and has no coordinates.', resolutionHint 'Use "Look up coordinates" in the target editor, or enter RA/Dec by hand.' Recommend reusing the same predicate rather than re-deriving it -- best home is a `bool get coordinatesUnset` getter on TargetHeaderNode (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/models/sequence/sequence_models/container_nodes/target_header_node.dart), which the app-side helper in screens/sequencer/widgets/target_coordinates.dart should then delegate to. Without that rule a user can still press Start with an unaimed target; the builder now warns in three places but cannot block the run.
